spec.description: Race Centre for the selected meeting: starting grid and strategy forecast before the race, then the full race analysis after the chequered flag.

options.content: ### 🏁 Race data appears here after the chequered flag.

spec.root_selector: $sort([qualifying_result.{"Pos": position, "Driver": driver, "Team": team, "Q1 (s)": q_times[0], "Q2 (s)": q_times[1], "Q3 (s)": q_times[2]}], function($a,$b){$a.Pos > $b.Pos})

spec.title: Degradation: lap time vs tyre age

spec.root_selector: ($p := session_pace; $order := [$sort($distinct($p.session), function($a,$b){$p[session = $a][0].session_start > $p[session = $b][0].session_start})]; $last := $order[-1] & " (s)"; $rows := [$distinct($p.driver).($d := $; $merge([{"Driver": $d, "Team": $p[driver = $d][0].team}, $order.($s := $; {($s & " (s)"): ($v := $p[driver = $d and session = $s][0].best_lap_seconds; $exists($v) ? $v : null)})]))]; $sort($rows, function($a,$b){($va := $lookup($a, $last); $vb := $lookup($b, $last); ($type($va) = "number" ? $va : 9999) > ($type($vb) = "number" ? $vb : 9999))}))

spec.root_selector: $sort([risk_by_year.($l := status = "no_data" ? "No data (before 2023)" : (status = "no_race" ? "No race" : ""); {"Year": $string(year), "Safety cars": $l != "" ? $l : $string(safety_cars), "Virtual safety cars": $l != "" ? "" : $string(virtual_safety_cars), "Red flags": $l != "" ? "" : $string(red_flags)})], function($a,$b){$a.Year > $b.Year})
$sort([$append($append(podiums.p1, podiums.p2), podiums.p3).{"label": driver & " · " & team, "colour": team_colour}], function($a,$b){$a.label > $b.label})

$sort([podiums.($l := status = "no_data" ? "No data (before 2023)" : (status = "no_race" ? "No race" : ""); {"Year": $string(year), "P1": $l != "" ? $l : p1.driver & " · " & p1.team, "P2": $l != "" ? "" : p2.driver & " · " & p2.team, "P3": $l != "" ? "" : p3.driver & " · " & p3.team})], function($a,$b){$a.Year > $b.Year})

results^(position).{"pos": position, "driver": driver, "team": team, "col": team_colour, "arrow": (grid_position - position) > 0 ? "▲" : ((grid_position - position) < 0 ? "▼" : "–"), "dn": $abs(grid_position - position), "dc": (grid_position - position) > 0 ? "#3fb950" : ((grid_position - position) < 0 ? "#f85149" : "#8b949e")}
